title: Comment on "A Bragg glass phase in the vortex lattice of a type II superconductor"
abstract: In a recent letter Klein et al. [Nature 413, 404 (2001); cond-mat/0110018] provide experimental evidence for the existence of the Bragg glass phase in impure type II superconductors. Here we show that a more complete consideration of recent theoretical findings allows an even better interpretation of the experimental data.
